app.name: Guition Speaker
app.summary: Adds mono I2S speaker output and a Home Assistant media player to the Guition ESP32-S3-4848S040.
app.description: Speaker-only audio support for the Guition 4-inch ESP32-S3-4848S040 with the NS4168 amplifier. Adds a Home Assistant media player and mono announcement/TTS playback. No microphone is configured.
